title: SLO contract enforcer and granular degradation profile
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: customers on Dedicated want stronger guarantees for committed throughput while avoiding hard capacity preemption that causes large quality regressions. This PR introduces an SLO Contract Enforcer service that binds per-tenant SLO contracts (throughput floor, burst allowance, degradation band) to autoscaler decisioning and a new Granular Degradation Profile DSL to express staged shedding strategies. Design summary: the enforcer receives validated contracts from the control plane, exposes a per-pool enforcement API consumed by the autoscaler, and publishes a small set of signals (contracted_rps, available_headroom, degrade_hint) to the routing plane. The degradation profile DSL (YAML) lets operators declare ordered steps (soft-throttle, kv-cache-preserve, selective-model-fallback, queued-backpressure) with thresholds and cool-downs. Integration: the autoscaler consults the enforcer during scale-down and burst reconciliation to avoid violating contracts; the admission controller uses degrade_hint to switch to preconfigured fallback model variants. Telemetry: adds percentile utilization (p50/p95/p99) per-tenant and per-pool, a degradation_event counter with reason tags, and a headroom_time_series exported to existing telemetry pipeline. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is a no-op unless a contract is present or a feature flag is enabled; existing autoscaler heuristics remain intact. Migration: control plane will seed contracts for customers on Dedicated via a Linear task (ENG-3421) and ops will enable canary on a subset of pools. Testing: unit and integration tests mock contract lifecycle; end-to-end smoke runs against a local dedicated cluster using synthetic load. Rollout: canary 5% pools for 24h -> 25% for 48h -> full with rollback thresholds (error spike >2x baseline or contract violation rate >0.1%). Risks & mitigations: incorrect profiles can cause excessive shedding; mitigation includes safe-mode where first degradation step is always a soft-throttle and immediate rollback if tail latency increases beyond threshold. See release notes and docs for configuration examples.

release_notes: Introduce SLO Contract Enforcer and Granular Degradation Profiles: enables per-tenant throughput guarantees with controlled degradation strategies. Adds ops UI for configuring SLO tiers, telemetry for percentile utilization and degradation events, and autoscaler integration to honor contracts during scale decisions.
rollout_plan: Canary 5% of Dedicated pools for 24h -> 25% for 48h -> 100%. Feature gated by 'slo-enforcer' flag in control plane; console UI behind 'slo-config' flag. Rollback triggers: contract violations >0.1% or tail latency > baseline x2.
notes_for_ops: Ops should seed contracts via controlplane API; sample contracts and playbook are in docs/ops/slo-contracts.md. Monitor slo_degradation_event and p99_utilization dashboards during canary.
how_to_test: Run tests/autoscaler/test_slo_enforcer.py locally; start a dedicated test pool with --feature-flag slo-enforcer and run the synthetic load harness from tools/synthetic-load with contract fixtures located in examples/slo-operators/fixtures.
